auditNotes.noteEnglish: QAC morphology and the word i‘rab call this a conditional noun. The ayah-level note treats the answering clause as a predicate, supporting the relative subject analysis. The linking fa answers ammaa. The effective app type remains noun.

The reviewed citation form is اِعْتَصَمَ. The lexeme evidence says the verb is followed by an explicit divine name at both cited occurrences. Here it is followed by بِهِۦ, whose pronoun refers to Allah in the translation.

The translation follows the supplied English translations and Sa‘di in referring the pronoun to Allah. Muyassar explains holding fast in terms of the revealed light from the preceding ayah. Both explanations are represented in the tafsir summary.
The raw QAC lemma is vocalized as a passive perfect. The actual indicative يُدْخِلُ is active, and the reviewed paradigm gives the active citation form أَدْخَلَ.
